nodes.name: Normalize Messages List
nodes.notes: Gmail returns no 'messages' key at all when there are zero results - this guarantees Split Out always sees an array, empty or not, so zero new mail is a clean no-op rather than a node error.

nodes.name: Insert Email
nodes.notes: resolution=ignore-duplicates means an already-seen gmail_message_id returns an empty array instead of erroring or duplicating - that's how re-running this workflow safely skips mail it already processed.

nodes.name: Prepare Attachments
